recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and dark denim jacket, set against a twilight background featuring a glowing red neon sign and a soft blue-to-pink sky. The composition is anchored by bold, two-tone sans-serif typography spanning the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head slightly tilted toward the upper right neon element
Warm orange and red accents in the background and text contrasting with cool blue sky tones
Textual elements layered directly over the subject's torso to create depth
Soft focus background elements emphasizing the sharp detail of the subject's face and clothing
coreInvariants: Tan cowboy hat with a curved brim
Dark, textured denim or canvas jacket
Glowing red neon signage in the upper right quadrant
Two-line horizontal text block in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally positioned, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright red neon sign in the upper right create a diagonal focal line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move up to the neon sign, then down to the large-scale typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant provides breathing room with a cloudy dusk sky.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and black (jacket and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and neon red (text and signage)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon and text against a desaturated, moody background palette.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color-coding to distinguish name from title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, classic American sans-serif aesthetic.
Provides the clean, geometric structure and tight tracking capability.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man with a beard wearing a tan cowboy hat and a dark denim jacket. He is standing outdoors at dusk. In the background, there is a glowing red neon sign for a bar and a soft blue and pink twilight sky. The lighting should be moody with warm highlights on his face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, bold, uppercase sans-serif text across the lower third of the image. The first part of the top line should be in a vibrant burnt orange, and the rest of the text should be in stark white. The text should have tight tracking and be left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the lower third?
Is the cowboy hat tan and well-lit?
Is there a red neon element in the background?
Is the font a bold, clean sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the orange text
Tightness of the camera crop on the subject
mustRedesign: Specific brand names on the neon sign
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the orange text color is legible against the dark jacket.
Verify the neon sign has a realistic glow effect.
Confirm the sky gradient is smooth and natural.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rugged male portrait in western attire with a dusk urban/rural background and bold, two-tone sans-serif typography in the lower third to create a contemporary country aesthetic.
